feeds.title: SWAGGER Magazine » Style
feeds.description: The SWAGGER men's lifestyle blog features all things for the men of tomorrow. Focusing on business, careers, fashion, style, grooming, gadgets, technology, food and drinks and everything men covet. SWAGGER Magazine is North America's Premier digital first Modern Men's Luxury Lifestyle Publication. It is the new go-to resource for the ambitious, successful, and influential gentlemen of today.

feeds.title: preferred Magazine » Fashion
feeds.description: It is Canada's leading Men's Fashion magazine. They cover the latest in Men's fashion, trends, lifestyle, grooming, Fitness, designs, and culture. Preferred Magazine is a Toronto-based men's luxury lifestyle publication with a global perspective and reach. Unafraid to challenge industry clichés, it stands apart with its attention to detail and original content designed to stimulate, educate, and entertain.

feeds.title: Sharp Magazine » Style
feeds.description: Find out the latest style news, trend updates, and styling guides from those in the know. Sharp is a magazine for men to invest in their personal brand. It is an information and entertainment resource about the best things in life and living well.

feeds.title: Tip Top Blog
feeds.description: With a huge assortment of colors and fits, Tip Top has everything you need to look your absolute best, whatever the occasion. Find men's suits, dress shirts, ties, jackets, how to style them, & more. From a wedding to a casual look, the blog offers males an insight into styling themselves.

feeds.title: Boutique Ernest Blog
feeds.description: Discover the trends in men's fashion with Boutique Ernest's collections of quality clothing ranging from chic to sporty. They sell medium to upscale private label and branded clothing. Their looks range from sportswear to business attire. They offer full services for men to dress from head to toe.

feeds.title: Christian Confidential
feeds.description: Christian Confidential is a carefully curated lifestyle blog tailored to fashion, fitness, travel & pop culture. From street-style fashion to workout tips, travel recommendations, and more. It is your one-stop shop for the stylish, always curious & forward-thinking reader!

feeds.title: Eddie's Men's Wear Blog
feeds.description: Eddie's Men's Wear has been helping men look their best since 1958. Through every decade, phase, fad, and season, their aim has always been to focus on quality, value, and the customer. Their encyclopedic product knowledge would make Google cry. They know what works, and what doesn't, and they can guess your size just by looking.

feeds.title: Menswhere.ca
feeds.description: Shane Schick, Editor-at-Large with Swagger magazine spends his time as a business journalist, he also works as a content marketing consultant, helping some of the biggest companies tell stories that influence the strategic thinking of their most valuable customers. Due to the nature of his work, he gets to travel, talk with interesting people and enjoy some of the best food and drink. That made him appreciate the creativity that goes into fashion, interior design, and even cocktails. With this blog, he shares his knowledge of dressing up for an occasion.

feeds.title: THE PREP GUY
feeds.description: The Prep Guy is a men's fashion and lifestyle blog created by Canada's leading plus-size male model, Syed Sohail. We are a men's fashion and lifestyle destination for Modern Canadian and American males. It focuses on providing fashion, lifestyle, beauty, grooming, and self-confidence advice for men of all shapes and body types.
